# nico_user (Data Source)

User is a logical entity that identifies individuals operating on behalf of an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_user" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "user_name" {
  value = data.nico_user.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The date that the user was created.
- `email` (String) Email used by the user to register with NGC
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `last_name` (String) Surname of the user
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the user was last updated in NICo
